acceptanceCriteria: tools/cem-citation-baseline emits grep-bot and pre-image arms beside the authored map; forged-ID and path-inventory maps are sealed fixtures; decision 0523 gains a kill criterion requiring authored maps to beat the mechanical arms on a statistic the arms cannot max out, or records that anchored is not a support measure.
body:
Panel findings (adversary + eval-method), reproduced on f8ea0758e:
- A map whose every hunk does the opposite of the spec it cites, with a `// satisfies <ID>` comment and the defining line cited, scores anchored 24/24 specificity 24 (panel/adversary/out-B_forgedid.json); a path-inventory map scores the same (out-C_pathanchor.json); the honest careful fixture scores 16/16. A map with 24 unknown hunks is ACCEPT exit 0 (out-F_unknown.json).
- A mechanical grep bot that reads only the diff's paths and IDs then greps base-tree specs anchors 73% of hunks on 24 corpus maps; authored maps anchor 5.1% on the same maps (panel/eval-method/grepbot-60.jsonl). Pooled excess anchored over a 200-derangement null is 2.1% of supported hunks, CI [1.7%, 2.5%].
- Decision 0523 K2 only requires rubber-stamp and careful blocks to differ; the 12.9x lift is against a cross-map null that cannot name this change's paths. No criterion tests anchored against a cheap mechanical producer, and no fixture separates forged-careful from careful.
Expected under decision 0523: anchored is verifier-computed support a producer cannot manufacture. Actual: it measures lexical coincidence available from the diff alone.

Version: origin/main f8ea0758ee1b77bb45931818e47ae1a9a95d1d59 (2026-10-13). Panel evidence (scratch, not retained in-tree): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-russelllewis-projects-corvint/b89960c8-2163-4353-8ea9-7b6117332c1b/scratchpad/panel/<lens>/.
title: Anchored tier is forgeable: grep-bot and forged-ID maps outscore the careful fixture; add mechanical-producer arms and forged-careful kill criteria
